intent: Sustained forward trot at 0.1 m/s on Sesame's 8-joint (2-DoF-per-leg) vertical-axis hips, using direct smooth joint curves with diagonal pair A=(RF,LR) and pair B=(RR,LF) offset by half a cycle; constant base height, no clipping or ground correction.

phases.name: pairA stance / pairB swing (early)
phases.base_motion: Constant forward velocity 0.1 m/s along world x, y=0, constant base height 0.04673357 m, zero roll/pitch/yaw.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A (RF,LR) in stance: hips sweep back via cos wave, knees held at stance flex 0.15 rad. Pair B (RR,LF) in swing: hips sweep forward, knees flex up to 0.15+0.58 rad following normalized sine arch over swing.

phases.name: pairA stance / pairB swing (late)
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward translation and constant base height.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A continues stance sweep; pair B completes swing arch and begins touchdown extension as its phase approaches 0.5 wrap.

phases.name: pairB stance / pairA swing (early)
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward translation and constant base height.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B now in stance with knees at 0.15 rad; pair A swings forward with knee lift arch up to 0.73 rad peak.

phases.name: pairB stance / pairA swing (late)
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward translation and constant base height.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B finishes stance sweep; pair A completes swing and extends for touchdown, wrapping smoothly to phase 0.

coding_notes: Parameters: freq=2.52 Hz, hip amplitude A=0.268 rad, hip center=1.595 rad, stance knee flex=0.15 rad, swing knee lift=0.58 rad, phase origin=0.12, base height=0.04673357 m. Phase pA = frac(freq*t + 0.12); pB = frac(pA+0.5). Hips: R1=center+A*cos(2pi*pA); R2=pi-center+A*cos(2pi*pB); L1=pi-center-A*cos(2pi*pB); L2=center-A*cos(2pi*pA). Knees: swingA = pA>=0.5, swingB = pB>=0.5; sA=(pA-0.5)*2, sB=(pB-0.5)*2; archA=sin(pi*sA), archB=sin(pi*sB); flexA=where(swingA, 0.15+0.58*archA, 0.15); flexB=where(swingB, 0.15+0.58*archB, 0.15); R3=pi-flexA, L4=pi-flexA, R4=flexB, L3=flexB. Stack q=[R1,R3,R2,R4,L1,L3,L2,L4]. Root: x=home['speed']*t, y=0, z=0.04673357*(1+0*t); rpy all zero. Contacts: contactA=pA<0.5, contactB=pB<0.5; stack [contactA, contactB, contactB, contactA] for order RF,RR,LF,LR. No clipping, no projection, no ground correction; swing sine normalized to 0..1 to avoid wrap discontinuity.
